descriptionHtml:
GIGABYTE GS25F2A 24.5 FHD 240Hz SuperSpeed IPS Gaming Monitor (24.5 Inch Full HD 1920x1080 / Ultra-Fast 240Hz Refresh Rate / SuperSpeed IPS Panel / 1ms GTG Response Time / 120% sRGB Color Gamut / HDR10 / Built-in 2x 2W Speakers / DisplayPort 1.4 & Dual HDMI 2.0 / Eyesafe 2.0 & Flicker-Free / 3 Years Official Local Agent Warranty)

Dominate the competitive esports arena with the GIGABYTE GS25F2A 24.5-inch FHD gaming monitor, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with an Official 3-Year Local Agent Warranty. Engineered for high-speed action, this display features a SuperSpeed IPS panel delivering a blazing 240Hz refresh rate and a rapid 1ms GTG response time to eliminate motion blur and input lag. With 120% sRGB color gamut coverage, HDR10 visual enhancement, built-in stereo speakers, and Eyesafe 2.0 low blue light protection, it delivers ultra-smooth gameplay without compromising color vibrancy or eye comfort.
